newsitem.title: USA: PACE Health '96 hurt by $1.3 mln writedown.
newsitem.headline: PACE Health '96 hurt by $1.3 mln writedown.

text.p: PACE Health Management Systems Inc said a $1.3 million writedown of computer software development costs hurt its 1996 results.
For the quarter, it posted a loss of $0.19 a share and for the full year, a loss of $1.06 a share.
"Excluding this writedown, operating results for both the quarter and year to date approximated market expectations," said chief financial officer Roger Huseman in a statement.

The developer and marketer of advanced patient care management software noted that it recently signed a multimillion dollar agreement to provide its Care Management Systems to Moses H. Cone Health Systems in Greensboro, N.C.
PACE Health Systems was off 3/8 at 3-3/8.
